exposure: Trimester of childbirth (March-May, June-August, September-November, corresponding to pandemic phases)
cohort: The study included uninfected and asymptomatically infected women giving birth at a tertiary care center in Lombardy, northern Italy.
finding: The study found increased rates of gestational diabetes mellitus, spontaneous preterm birth, and neuraxial analgesia in 2020 compared to 2019, with different temporal distributions across the pandemic phases.
mod_finding: An increased rate of neuraxial analgesia was observed in 2020 compared to 2019, particularly during the first wave of the pandemic.
